method: CEFR-informed learner-owned original modular curriculum; level and grammar allocations are pedagogical draft, not official CEFR grammar mandates.
level_scope: A1-B2 structured core; C1-C2 advanced extension blueprint requires additional expert source alignment

units.title: Greetings and identity
units.can_do: Introduce yourself and ask basic identity questions

units.title: Things around me
units.can_do: Name everyday items and identify ownership

units.title: Home and directions
units.can_do: Describe a room and give simple directions
units.performance_task: Explain a route through your home

units.title: Daily routines
units.can_do: Describe ordinary habits and ask about routines

units.title: Questions and social life
units.can_do: Ask and answer simple WH questions

units.title: Shopping and prices
units.can_do: Ask about quantities, cost and preferences

units.title: Abilities and hobbies
units.can_do: Describe interests and what you can do

units.title: Weather and plans
units.can_do: Talk about weather and near-future plans

units.title: Yesterday and last week
units.performance_task: Tell three things you did yesterday

units.title: Travel and everyday help
units.can_do: Handle transport, directions and a simple problem
units.performance_task: Give directions and ask for help

units.title: Growing routines
units.can_do: Contrast habits and actions happening now

units.title: Experiences
units.can_do: Talk about life experiences and recent events

units.title: Health and suggestions
units.can_do: Discuss symptoms and give basic advice

units.title: Food quantities and services
units.can_do: Order and request services in detail

units.title: Rules and possibilities
units.can_do: Discuss rules, obligations and likely outcomes

units.title: Messages and everyday writing
units.can_do: Write short messages and explain an experience
units.performance_task: Write and read a brief email

units.title: Storytelling and narrative
units.can_do: Tell coherent stories with background and sequence

units.title: Experience and change
units.can_do: Explain experiences and changes over time

units.title: Goals and regrets
units.performance_task: Advise a friend on a choice

units.title: Work and studies
units.can_do: Participate in school and workplace discussions

units.title: Evidence and uncertainty
units.can_do: Evaluate claims and degrees of certainty

units.title: Formal explanation
units.can_do: Explain complex processes in formal register

units.title: Meetings and debate
units.can_do: Lead a discussion and respond to counterarguments

units.title: Precision and style
units.can_do: Select precise register and word choices

units.title: Fine shades of meaning
units.can_do: Recognize and produce subtle semantic distinctions

units.title: Audience adaptation
units.performance_task: Adapt one speech for two audiences

units.title: Humor and cultural inference
units.can_do: Interpret humor and indirect social cues

units.title: Mastery portfolio
units.can_do: Create a cohesive self-selected body of work

units.title: Nationalités et langues
units.performance_task: Présentez votre pays et vos langues

units.title: Famille et entourage
units.performance_task: Décrivez une personne de votre famille

units.title: Objets et espaces
units.can_do: Name objects and describe the classroom

units.title: Premiers récits
units.can_do: Talk briefly about a completed action
units.performance_task: Racontez une sortie en cinq phrases

units.title: Récits au passé
units.can_do: Tell a coherent account of completed events

units.title: Relations et messages
units.can_do: Talk about people and communicate politely

units.title: Futurs et invitations
units.performance_task: Invitez un ami à un événement

units.title: Raconter avec précision
units.can_do: Narrate events with background and consequence

units.title: Synthèse et prise de parole
units.can_do: Integrate several texts into coherent speech
units.performance_task: Faites une synthèse de cinq minutes

units.title: Précision lexicale
units.performance_task: Réécrivez un texte pour la nuance

units.title: Exposé expert
units.can_do: Explain complex ideas to varied audiences
